description: List a project member's in-progress missions. A task is linked to a mission-in-progress the assignee performs, so call this after choosing the assignee (a person) to pick the missionId to pass to createTaskTool. If no mission in progress covers the work, it is not a task: prepare a mission with prepareMissionTool instead. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getMemberMissionsTool

userId.description: ID of the member (assignee) whose in-progress missions to list

name: getMemberMissionsTool
